gates.requiredScope: Validate run identity and all four accepted input byte hashes before every mutable phase and after interruption.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File .specify/presets/autonomous-run-governance/scripts/validate-autonomous-run-state.ps1 -State specs/005-sandbox-secure-development/autonomous-run-state.json

pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$state = Get-Content -LiteralPath "specs/005-sandbox-secure-development/autonomous-run-state.json" -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach ($item in $state.acceptedArtifacts) { $actual = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $item.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); if ($actual -ne $item.sha256) { throw "Accepted input drift: $($item.path)" } }; "PASS: accepted inputs"'
gates.rationale: Input drift invalidates every downstream assessment and delivery claim.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Every phase boundary, resume, commit, push, and remote delivery step.

gates.requiredScope: Confirm the separate Sandbox reference is read-only observed at the exact accepted commit without persisting its private host root.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command 'if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:SANDBOX_REFERENCE_ROOT)) { throw "SANDBOX_REFERENCE_ROOT not set" }; $head = git -C $env:SANDBOX_REFERENCE_ROOT rev-parse HEAD; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $head -ne "05d1202b3364cba3d0e48e6c32e10b34a62ba1f0") { throw "Sandbox reference drift" }; "PASS: immutable Sandbox reference"'
gates.rationale: Only committed Sandbox facts are reproducible and public-ready evidence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Sandbox commit, image identity, or reference-document change.

gates.requiredScope: Record the result files missing before implementation and the unchanged contract passing after the smallest documentation slice.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$required = @("specs/005-sandbox-secure-development/sandbox-assessment.md", "specs/005-sandbox-secure-development/evidence-matrix.md"); $missing = @($required | Where-Object { -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ -PathType Leaf) }); if ($missing.Count) { throw "Missing assessment outputs: $($missing -join ', ')" }; "PASS: assessment output files"'
gates.rationale: Pure governance work uses an observable document-contract red/green slice instead of product TDD.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any required assessment output or contract change.

gates.requiredScope: Require all twelve canonical CL-12 IDs once and all status, ownership, rationale, evidence, risk, trigger, and follow-up fields.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$path = "specs/005-sandbox-secure-development/sandbox-assessment.md"; $text = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw -Encoding UTF8; $sections = @([regex]::Matches($text, "(?ms)^### (CL-12-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])).*?(?=^### CL-12-|\z)")); $ids = @($sections | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value }); if ($ids.Count -ne 12 -or @($ids | Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne 12) { throw "Expected 12 unique CL-12 sections" }; foreach ($section in $sections) { foreach ($token in @("Applicability", "Implementation status", "Learning stage", "Responsible role", "Evidence", "Residual risk", "Re-evaluation trigger", "Next action")) { if ($section.Value -notmatch [regex]::Escape($token)) { throw "$($section.Groups[1].Value) lacks $token" } } }; "PASS: CL-12 completeness"'
gates.rationale: A complete assessment may retain Open findings but may not omit a checklist item or required field.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: CL-12 version, assessment row, status, or evidence change.

gates.requiredScope: Require symbolic mount and work-location matrices that deny unrelated host, profile, key, and project surfaces.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$text = Get-Content -LiteralPath "specs/005-sandbox-secure-development/sandbox-assessment.md" -Raw -Encoding UTF8; foreach ($token in @("<TinyPl0-repository>", "ReadOnly", "ReadWrite", "NotMounted", "Build", "Test", "CI", "HumanOnly")) { if ($text -notmatch [regex]::Escape($token)) { throw "Boundary matrix lacks $token" } }; "PASS: mount and work-location boundaries"'
gates.rationale: A broad host or adjacent-project mount defeats the TinyPl0-only agent boundary.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Mount, writable-root, agent-mode, work-location, or host-platform change.

gates.requiredScope: Map security, architecture, accessibility, supply-chain, regulatory, and all eight preset decisions with rationale and triggers.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$text = Get-Content -LiteralPath "specs/005-sandbox-secure-development/evidence-matrix.md" -Raw -Encoding UTF8; foreach ($token in @("NIST SSDF", "CWE Top 25", "SBOM", "VEX", "AI-SBOM", "SLSA", "OpenSSF", "SAMM", "Zero Trust", "WCAG 2.2", "security-governance", "parallel-autonomous-run-governance")) { if ($text -notmatch [regex]::Escape($token)) { throw "Evidence matrix lacks $token" } }; "PASS: standards and presets"'
gates.rationale: Silent standards or preset omission would invalidate the Level-2 assessment.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Constitution, preset, standard, or applicability change.

gates.requiredScope: Reject product, test, workflow, existing docs/security, and any Sandbox repository change from the TinyPl0 feature delivery set.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$base = git merge-base main HEAD; $allowed = "^(\.specify/feature\.json|specs/005-sandbox-secure-development/|docs/project-statistics\.(md|config\.json)$|src/Pl0\.Ide/Pl0\.Ide\.csproj$)"; $paths = @((git diff --name-only $base HEAD); (git diff --name-only); (git diff --cached --name-only); (git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)) | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique; $bad = @($paths | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch $allowed }); if ($bad.Count) { throw "Out-of-scope path: $($bad -join ', ')" }; "PASS: bounded delivery paths"'
gates.rationale: The intake forbids technical hardening and automatic population of existing security evidence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Every edit, commit, delivery-set freeze, and exact-head validation.

gates.requiredScope: Scan only intended public delivery files for secret patterns and concrete private host paths without reading forbidden local state.
exactCommands: gitleaks git --redact --log-opts=main..HEAD

pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$diffLines = @((git diff --no-ext-diff --unified=0 main...HEAD --); (git diff --no-ext-diff --unified=0 --); (git diff --cached --no-ext-diff --unified=0 --)); $candidateText = @($diffLines | Where-Object { $_ -match "^\+(?!\+\+)" } | ForEach-Object { $_.Substring(1) }); $untracked = @(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard); foreach ($file in $untracked) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file -PathType Leaf) { $candidateText += Get-Content -LiteralPath $file -Raw -Encoding UTF8 } }; $unixPrefix = ([char]47) + "Users" + ([char]47); $winPrefix = ([char]92) + "Users" + ([char]92); $pattern = [regex]::Escape($unixPrefix) + "[^/<\s]+|[A-Za-z]:" + [regex]::Escape($winPrefix) + "[^\\<\s]+"; if (($candidateText -join "`n") -match $pattern) { throw "Private host path in added delivery content" }; "PASS: no concrete private host paths in added delivery content"'
gates.rationale: Public evidence must not leak credentials or identify a private host layout.

gates.requiredScope: Require DE-first/EN-second, CEFR-B2, semantic headings, text status, tagged code blocks, and no visual-only decision.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath "specs/005-sandbox-secure-development" -Filter "*.md" -Recurse); foreach ($file in $files) { $text = Get-Content -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Raw -Encoding UTF8; if ($text -match "(?m)^```$") { throw "Untagged code block: $($file.FullName)" } }; "PASS: tagged code blocks and text-first review"'
gates.rationale: The assessment is learner-facing and must remain usable without visual layout or color.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Every learner-facing text, table, code block, or navigation change.

gates.requiredScope: Do not claim a new local product build, test, coverage, DocFX, or Sandbox execution for documentation-only scope.
gates.rationale: No product code, public API, test, XML documentation, or generated site is changed; remote CI remains delivery regression evidence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any product, test, API, XML, DocFX, workflow, or dependency change.

gates.requiredScope: Align all IDE version fields to the actual allocated PR number, exact feature-head commit count, and current build counter before final review.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$pr = gh pr view --json number | ConvertFrom-Json; $expectedMinor = [int]$pr.number; $expectedPatch = [int](git rev-list --count HEAD); [xml]$xml = Get-Content -LiteralPath "src/Pl0.Ide/Pl0.Ide.csproj" -Raw -Encoding UTF8; $values = @($xml.Project.PropertyGroup.Version, $xml.Project.PropertyGroup.AssemblyVersion, $xml.Project.PropertyGroup.FileVersion); foreach ($value in $values) { $version = [version]$value; if ($version.Minor -ne $expectedMinor -or $version.Build -ne $expectedPatch) { throw "IDE version drift" } }; if (@($values | Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne 1) { throw "IDE version fields diverge" }; "PASS: governed IDE version"'
git diff --check
git status --short --untracked-files=all
gates.rationale: Repository policy binds every agent-created commit and PR branch to traceable IDE version metadata.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Commit count, PR allocation, build/test invocation, or branch update.

gates.requiredScope: Require successful exact-head CI, zero actionable threads, and independent human Approval before merge; COMMENTED, unavailable, or bypass is insufficient.
exactCommands: gh pr checks --watch --fail-fast
gh pr view --json url,headRefOid,reviewDecision,reviews,statusCheckRollup
gh api graphql -f query='query($owner:String!,$name:String!,$number:Int!){repository(owner:$owner,name:$name){pullRequest(number:$number){reviewThreads(first:100){nodes{isResolved}}}}}'
gates.rationale: Admin Bypass may address platform policy only after technical and independent-review evidence; it cannot create Approval.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Every PR-head, check, review, thread, or authority change.

gates.requiredScope: After actual merge, synchronize main, archive the binding intake byte-identically, update series lineage, and validate the next serial state.
exactCommands: gh repo sync --branch main
pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File .specify/presets/intake-sequencing-governance/scripts/validate-intake-series.ps1 -Manifest requirements/intakes/series/tinypl0-delivery/manifest.json -RepositoryRoot .
pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File .specify/presets/autonomous-run-governance/scripts/validate-autonomous-run-state.ps1 -State specs/005-sandbox-secure-development/autonomous-run-state.json
gates.rationale: Only post-merge facts can causally complete the intake lifecycle and successor eligibility.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Merge result, main revision, manifest, receipt, archive, or successor status change.
